summary: Verified BOTH bug fixes end-to-end. (1) Admin two-step inline-confirm delete for demo-videos works — first click transitions the button to red-bg + animate-pulse with label 'Click to confirm'; second click within 4s calls DELETE /api/admin/demo-videos/{id}, removes the row, shows 'Deleted.' toast, and the video disappears from public GET /api/demo-videos. (2) Landing DemoVideoCarousel is visibly smaller — measured live: section padding 40px (py-10), headline 20px (text-xl), halo 440x440, cards 240px wide, arrows 32x32. Auto-cancel after 4s also verified. Backend regression (POST + PUT + DELETE + public GET) 4/4 passed via pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: Two-click confirm UX is implemented correctly: state stored in `confirmDeleteId` (parent), passed as `pendingConfirm` prop to row, cleared by setTimeout 4000ms in a dedicated useEffect. Return cleanup via clearTimeout properly avoids stale timers.
Delete button correctly toggles between red-outline 'Delete' and solid bg-red-600 + animate-pulse 'Click to confirm' — matches the acceptance spec exactly.

DemoVideoCarousel sizing matches spec: measured live dims are py-10 (40px), h2 text-xl (20px), halo 440px, cards md:w-[240px] (240px measured), arrows w-8 h-8 (32px measured). Total section height ~555px on desktop, meaningfully smaller than before.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway demo-video rows created via POST /api/admin/demo-videos ('TEST_UI_DELETE_ME' and 'TEST_AUTOCANCEL') — both deleted at end of test flow. DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo videos admin CMS delete flow and landing-page carousel sizing are fully verified as of iteration_44. Backend endpoints (public GET, admin GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) confirmed working with correct auth. Two-click delete pattern is the CORRECT solution for the preview-iframe (window.confirm is silently blocked). If a next session touches DemoVideoCarousel.jsx or DemoVideosAdmin.jsx, re-run `pytest backend/tests/test_demo_videos_delete.py` for quick regression and eyeball the /app/test_reports/demo_carousel_smaller.png against the new build.
